newsitem.title: USA: Mexican plane evacuated after bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Mexican plane evacuated after bomb threat.

text.p: A Mexicana Airlines passenger plane was evacuated on Wednesday at a northern California airport after the airline received a bomb threat, airport officials said.
"Mexicana directly received a bomb threat and immediately isolated the aircraft and the passengers," San Jose International Airport spokeswoman Cathy Gaskell said.
Mexicana flight 953, with 163 passengers on board and a full crew, was bound for Guadalajara, and was then scheduled to fly to Mexico City.
Authorities in San Jose, located about 40 miles (64 km) south of San Francisco, said the bomb threat was made to airline officials at about 9:30 a.m. local time (1730 GMT).
San Jose police, the FBI and federal aviation officials were searching the plane, its luggage and cargo in a remote part of the airport for any explosives.
"They're going through every inch," Gaskell said, adding that no devices have been found yet. An airline spokesperson was not immediately available to comment on the incident.
"The hope is they'll get back on their plane and get to their destinations for Christmas," Gaskell said.
